answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 16628 Country: India Title: In continuation with Question #: 16005 Respected Maulana, Assalamualiakum Wa rahamatullahi barkatahu, I am in very great trouble now. The girl whom I got married is having an affair with someone. Due to this she had asked me many times to give talaq. Since I did not knew that she loves someone I had ignored this. She has clearly written in one letter and also told me about this later. I did not share this (she loves someone else and talaq matter) with her parents. Few days before she went to her sister?s house and said to her parents that I have given talaq to her 3 to 4 times. Those people came to my house and beat me and blamed my sister that she has spoiled their daughter?s life. She lie a lot (even takes oath on Quran). While getting married I was told my many people who know her family that they strictly follow Islam. But now I know that they are not. Her father had died few years back before my marriage. She has taken all jewelry give by us. I do not want to spend rest of my life with a liar who does not fear Allah and the Day of Judgment. Please help me. In eleven months of our marriage she hardly stayed with me for 2 months. Please let me know what will be compensation I should give? Will I get back the jewelry (not mahar) give by me? Are there any other chargers (extra money) applicable? Allah knows better, Thanks in advance Regards!
